concepts.def: An organised, persistent store of data.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Database Concepts — a core area of GCSE Computer Science.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Database Concepts brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Database Concepts.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: What is the scope of a local variable?
options: Accessible only within the function/block where it is declared.
Stored on a local computer rather than a server.
To make the function run faster.
Accessible everywhere in the program.
